passages.text: Plants of the World Online account: Cenchrus × cupreus (Thorpe) Govaerts.
The native range of this hybrid is as a cultigen derived from artificial hybrids. It is a perennial and grows primarily in the subtropical biome. The hybrid formula is C. elegans × C. setaceus.
